fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Front Driveway; Access Drive; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Green Space; Dense Vegetation; Landscaped Area
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Turnaround Space; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly on both sides so responders arriving under low-visibility conditions can identify it without delay.
• Trim vegetation along the sides of the access drive so responders can move along it without obstruction.
• Clear a designated turnaround area near the residence large enough for an emergency vehicle to reverse and exit without backing the full length of the driveway.
• Cut back dense vegetation growing close to the main residence and detached structure so responders can move around the buildings on foot.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of parked vehicles along the path between the driveway and both structures so responders can reach either building directly.
• Thin dense vegetation between the two structures to keep a clear walking path open for responders moving between them.
• Post the property address visibly at the driveway entrance and again near the residence so responders can confirm they are at the correct location.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Shrubs; Mixed Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Ground Vegetation; Open Terrain; Single Access Route; Long Driveway; Limited Rear Access; Scattered Trees
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that extend over or directly touch the house roof and walls.
• Thin trees in clusters near the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the foundation and exterior walls.
• Clear ground vegetation within several feet of the house on all sides.
• Separate shrubs from nearby trees so fire cannot travel from low plants up into tree canopy.
• Thin mixed vegetation on the sides of the driveway so vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Keep the full length of the driveway clear of overhanging branches low enough to block emergency vehicles.
• Remove dead or dry ground cover that connects vegetation patches around the structure.
• Clear vegetation along the rear of the property to allow movement around the back of the house.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is visible from the road, given the single access point and long approach.
• Maintain a mowed or cleared strip along both edges of the driveway for its full length.
• Thin trees scattered around the structure so none stand close enough to fall onto the house.
